channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Asia leads global confidence in tax fairness, India stands out: Report
item.description: Nearly 45 per cent of Indian respondents believe that tax revenues are spent for the public good, while 41 per cent view paying taxes as a contribution to their community rather than an additional cost, reinforcing the idea of tax as a shared civic responsibility, according to the report released jointly by ACCA, IFAC, Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand (CA ANZ) and the OECD.

item.title: Abducted and converted to Islam: Report highlights plight of Christian girls in Pakistan
item.description: Speaking to Pakistan Christian Post, her family revealed that, in reality, Monica had been abducted and forcibly converted. A Protestant pastor, Imran Amanat, said that Christian girls remain at high risk in Pakistan, a report in Australia-based The Catholic Weekly highlighted.

item.title: Venezuelan catalyst: Reckoning for global oil architecture
item.description: Venezuela's post-intervention stability might add substantial supply and devastate Russia's economy, where oil constitutes 40 percent of exports, while prolonged chaos could perpetuate global shortages.

item.title: Three killed in fire at Delhi Metro quarters in Adarsh Nagar
item.description: According to Delhi Fire Services (DFS), they received information at around 02:39 a.m. about a fire on the second floor of one of the buildings in the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) staff quarters in Adarsh Nagar.

item.title: Shots fired near Venezuelan presidential palace, govt buildings evacuated
item.description: The source added that unidentified drones flew over the presidential palace in central Caracas, prompting security forces to open fire in response, Xinhua news agency reported.Earlier on Monday, US President Donald Trump said that Venezuela will not hold elections in the next 30 days.

item.title: Amitabh Bachchan feels "stuck" after Kaun Banega Crorepati ends
item.description: Amitabh Bachchan has shared that the days seem too long and boring to him after the end of KBC.

item.title: Almost 7 million Australians living in areas most exposed to deadly wildfires: Report
item.description: According to the report, the number of Australians living in the outer suburbs of major cities has increased by 65.5 per cent since 2001 to over 6.9 million and up to 90 per cent of Australian homes in high-risk fire zones were built before modern bushfire-resilient standards were introduced, Xinhua news agency reported.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post mild losses as oil and gas stocks trade lower
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex slipped 246 points, or 0.29 per cent to 85,193 and Nifty eased 70 points, or 0.27 per cent to 26,180.

item.title: Who is Kartik Aaryan vacationing with in Goa? Reddit digs out cosy beach getaway photos
item.description: Kartik Aaryan is reportedly vacationing in Goa with a mystery girl. Interestingly, he was following her on Instagram until the photos were shared on Reddit. Soon after the discussion gained traction online, he unfollowed her, further fuelling the speculation.

item.title: Agastya Nanda schooled for distancing himself from 'Bachchan' surname: "That's your literal grandpa"
item.description: Agastya Nanda tries to distance himself from the 'Bachchan' legacy in latest interview, gets trolled and schooled.
